settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.description: Playback setting title. Immediate D-pad jumps while controls are hidden; default Off.

settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.c.value: With controls hidden, Left/Right jumps by the skip interval. With controls visible, OK confirms. Off keeps reveal-first navigation.
settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.c.description: Explanation of optional D-pad seeking. Dedicated rewind and fast-forward work independently.

settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.o.description: Choice for the Instant D-pad seeking setting.
Choice for the Instant D-pad seeking setting.

settings.playback.dolby_vision.description: Playback setting title. Whether Dolby Vision is used when the TV supports it; default Auto.

settings.playback.dolby_vision.copy.value: Auto uses Dolby Vision when the TV supports it. Off plays the HDR10 layer instead. Files with no HDR10 layer are converted by your Plex server, and may not play.
settings.playback.dolby_vision.copy.description: Explanation of the Dolby Vision playback setting. Names the picker's two labels: settings.playback.auto and settings.playback.dolby_vision.off. Off can stop a file with no HDR10 layer (Dolby Vision Profile 5) from playing, because the server may refuse to convert it.

settings.playback.dolby_vision.off.description: Choice for the Dolby Vision setting (singular): Dolby Vision is never used.

settings.playback.passout_protection.description: Playback setting title and picker title: once nobody has pressed a button for a long time (the viewer has probably fallen asleep), a TV episode that is nearly over plays to its end, any other episode stops, and the next episode does not start by itself; movies are never affected; default Off. Its options are Off (settings.playback.passout_protection.off) and lengths in hours (settings.playback.passout_protection.hours).

settings.playback.passout_protection.cop.value: After this long without a button press, an episode with 20 minutes or less to go plays to its end, any other stops at once, and the next one does not start.
settings.playback.passout_protection.cop.description: Explanation under the title of the Passout protection picker. Once the chosen time has passed without a button press, a TV episode with 20 minutes or less left plays to its end, an episode with more left stops at once (keeping its resume point), and the next episode does not start by itself; the player then goes back to the page it was opened from. Movies are never affected; pressing Next Episode always works.

settings.playback.passout_protection.off.description: Choice for the Passout protection setting (the default): the next episode always starts by itself as the Next episode setting says.

settings.playback.passout_protection.hou.description: Choice for the Passout protection setting and the row's read-out: how long without a button press before an episode is stopped or allowed to finish without starting the next one (1, 2 or 3 hours).
